sources.title: Stay (2005)
sources.snippet: *   See production info at IMDbPro. Image 5: Watch on Indie Club. Sign in to see this summary and all user reviews. I too was part of a test audience for this film. It's an experimental film putting the audience to the test all the time, a puzzle much more then a thriller motion picture. Although it is rightly classified as a drama, it is in many ways a mystery, and like the best mysteries, the clues are all there, but the story itself becomes so compelling that the viewer is too involved in what is happening on the screen to put the clues together and solve the mystery. After you have watched it and thought about it for a while, go to YouTube and watch one of several analyses of the film which may help you appreciate how skillful a film this really is. I saw this in the cinema solely because I had nothing else to do and that Ewan McGregor was in it.

sources.snippet: *   To save this word, you'll need to log in.Log In. # stay. **:**a large strong rope usually of wire used to support a mast. **:**to secure upright with or as if with stays. **:**to incline (a mast) forward, aft, or to one side by the stays. **:**to live in a place usually for a short time **:**lodge. **:**to stick or remain with (a race, a trial of endurance, etc.) to the end—usually used in the phrase _stay the course_. let's _stay_ at a quaint inn rather than at some generic motel Noun (2) my mother-in-law is coming for a brief _stay_ next week  we must work without _stay_ if we are ever to reach our goal of equal rights for everyone Noun (3) a free press is one of the principal _stays_ of a democratic society Verb (3) beams being used to _stay_ the bridge while it is undergoing repairs.

sources.title: Stay (2005 film)
sources.snippet: # *Stay* (2005 film). * Français "Stay (film, 2005) – French"). * Edit&action=edit "Edit this page [e]"). * What links here "List of all English Wikipedia pages containing links to this page [j]"). ***Stay*** is a 2005 American psychological thriller directed by Marc Forster and written by David Benioff. It stars Ewan McGregor, Naomi Watts, Ryan Gosling and Bob Hoskins, with production by Regency and distribution by 20th Century Fox. The film represents intense relationships centering on reality, love, death, suicide, and the afterlife. [edit&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Plot")]. Sam's new patient, Henry, is a college student and aspiring artist whom he describes as depressed and paranoid, with feelings of guilt and remorse. Henry, who earlier claimed his parents were dead, has his account contradicted by Sam when he finds Henry's mother and her dog living in a bare house, confused about Sam's identity and refusing to respond to questions.
